I am a woman of 51 years here in Dowa, and this small plot of about a third of a hectare I am putting to beans this season. Beans do not need much chemical fertilizer like maize does — they make their own goodness in the soil — so I will save my little money and just put some manure from the goats and chickens on it. I will use the seed I kept from last harvest because improved bean seed is expensive and hard to find at the market, and I have no way to irrigate, I must wait for the rains. My children and I will do most of the work ourselves, and maybe I will call one or two neighbors to help during planting and harvesting when the work is heavy.
